places.name: Picasso Artists
places.description: An art studio in Alserkal Avenue running painting classes and creative workshops for kids and adults, from total beginners to experienced painters. Check their Instagram for the class schedule and booking.

places.name: Snow Cinema at Ski Dubai
places.area: Ski Dubai, Mall of the Emirates
places.description: A small cinema set up on the snow inside Ski Dubai, run with VOX Cinemas: lounge seating, blankets and warm gear for watching a film surrounded by real snow. Arrive about 40 minutes early and dress in layers.

places.name: Brown Bear Magic Cafe & Shop
places.description: A small magic-themed cafe and shop run by the people behind the region's biggest online magic shop: coffee and snacks, card tricks, puzzles and magic kits for sale, and occasional live close-up magic.
